  },
  "metadata": {
    "description": "Antigravity plugin for Claude Code (agy / Gemini 3.x): a local NotebookLM (/agy:notebook — sweep a folder of documents into objective-driven summaries + relevance index + cited master synthesis), branded HTML report generation via the TRAID Design System (5 templates), deep web research with citations, multi-agent deep research (/agy:deep-research — plan → fan-out web browsing → reason → red-team → cited applied report), one-shot prompts, git-diff code review, code/task rescue, browser walkthrough recording, structured web scraping, document-to-markdown conversion, and visual/UX design review. Twenty-two slash commands (including audio & video transcription via /agy:transcribe and /agy:media), a thin Bash forwarder, no Node.js runtime. The modern successor to gemini-plugin-cc.",
    "version": "1.5.1",
    "homepage": "https://github.com/MarcosNahuel/antigravity-plugin-cc",
    "keywords": [
      "claude-code",
      "claude-code-plugin",
      "antigravity",
      "agy",
      "gemini",
      "gemini-3-5",
      "deep-research",
      "web-search",
      "ai-agents",
      "llm-tools",
      "agentic-engineering",
      "anthropic"
    ]
  },
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "antigravity",
      "description": "Twenty-two slash commands wrapping Google Antigravity CLI (agy): /agy:deep-research (multi-agent deep research — builds an evidence matrix + plan gate, then agy browses each angle while Claude orchestrates adaptive rounds L≤2/H≤4 + an agy red-team pass + synthesis with an applied recommendation; complements /agy:research, docs/agy/research/), /agy:transcribe (audio/video to a faithful transcript + summary; YouTube/remote URLs too), /agy:media (multimodal Q&A over an audio/video/image — time-referenced answers), /agy:notebook-ask (Q&A over a notebook corpus from the per-doc summaries, with citations), /agy:model (set the active agy model by writing ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json — the reliable lever; --model is unreliable), /agy:notebook (local NotebookLM — sweep a folder of documents into objective-driven per-doc summaries + a relevance INDEX.md + a cited RESUMEN_MAESTRO.md, hybrid text/vision OCR, docs/agy/notebook/), /agy:report (branded HTML from markdown via 5 TRAID Design System templates, docs/agy/reports/), /agy:ask (one-shot quick prompt), /agy:review (git-diff code review), /agy:research (deep web research with citations, docs/agy/research/), /agy:rescue (code/diagnosis task delegation), /agy:record (browser walkthrough recording — .webm + optional MP4 via ffmpeg), /agy:scrape (structured data extraction from URL — markdown or JSON), /agy:doc-to-md (PDF/docx/image to clean Markdown via multimodal Gemini), /agy:design-review (UX/visual audit with desktop+mobile screenshots and 10-dimension scoring), /agy:setup (health check). /agy:report supports --images native|external|none for reliable infographics (pre-generate with Nano Banana 2 for brand quality). Includes full issue-#76 handling (write_file workaround + transcript.jsonl recovery + headless auth-timeout detection + stdin-hang fix) and Windows rename-bug (#217) mitigation. Thin Bash forwarder, no runtime dependencies.",
      "version": "1.5.1",
      "author": {
        "name": "Marcos Nahuel Albornoz",
        "url": "https://github.com/MarcosNahuel"
      },
      "source": "./plugins/antigravity",
      "homepage": "https://github.com/MarcosNahuel/antigravity-plugin-cc",
      "license": "MIT"
    }
  ]
}
man:jianshuo/claude-skills:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-marketplace.json",
  "name": "claude-skills",
  "description": "33 Claude Code skills: a full video pipeline (transcribe / translate / dub / multicam / segment / overlay / reframe / upload / article→video / word→lesson), WeChat & content publishing (polish & draft / mine articles / mine voice memos / distill style / syndicate / tweet), X growth & engagement (improve content / grow followers / polish engagement / clean spam), site & app publishing (Hugo blog / WordPress→Hugo / TestFlight / App Store / in-site feedback loop), project auditing, skill self-promotion, and 吃一堑长一智 personal reflection. SKILL.md format — also compatible with OpenAI Codex CLI.",
  "owner": {"name": "Jianshuo Wang (王建硕)", "url": "https://github.com/jianshuo"},
  "plugins": [
    {"name": "wjs-transcribing-audio", "description": "Audio/video → timestamped SRT in the source language. Chinese uses Volcano ASR; other languages use OpenAI Whisper with word-level timestamps + punctuation-bounded re-segmentation.", "source": "./wjs-transcribing-audio"},
    {"name": "wjs-translating-subtitles", "description": "Translate an SRT from one language to another with punctuation-bounded re-segmentation. Simplified Chinese and English are first-class targets. Supports bilingual output.", "source": "./wjs-translating-subtitles"},
    {"name": "wjs-dubbing-video", "description": "Time-aligned TTS dub of a video against a target-language SRT. Volcano TTS for Chinese, edge-tts for everything else. Single-speaker by default; opt-in visual diarization for multi-speaker.", "source": "./wjs-dubbing-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-burning-subtitles", "description": "Final-composite step: burn SRT into pixels via libass, mix in a dub track, keep the original audio as a low-volume bed — all in one ffmpeg encode (no cascade).", "source": "./wjs-burning-subtitles"},
    {"name": "wjs-localizing-video", "description": "Thin orchestrator for the end-to-end video localization pipeline (transcribe → translate → dub → burn). Use it when the user asks for full localization in one go.", "source": "./wjs-localizing-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-syncing-multicam", "description": "Audio cross-correlation alignment for N recordings of the same event. Outputs `.sync.json` sidecars per file — never re-encodes the originals.", "source": "./wjs-syncing-multicam"},
    {"name": "wjs-editing-multicam", "description": "Auto-edit 2+ synced cams into a single MP4. Switches between angles second-by-second based on audio energy. Optional picture-in-picture.", "source": "./wjs-editing-multicam"},
    {"name": "wjs-segmenting-video", "description": "Cut a long-form interview / lecture / podcast into 3–6 stand-alone topical short clips, with per-clip SRT — ready for downstream post-production.", "source": "./wjs-segmenting-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-overlaying-video", "description": "Post-production overlays on top of a clip: AI-generated cover as first frame, HTML/CSS kinetic captions, illustration overlays, chapter chips, end-card CTA. HyperFrames-backed, single final encode.", "source": "./wjs-overlaying-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-reframing-video", "description": "Horizontal ↔ vertical conversion (16:9 ↔ 9:16, 4:3 ↔ 3:4). Crops a narrow band and tracks the active speaker via MediaPipe + mouth-aspect-ratio variance.", "source": "./wjs-reframing-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-uploading-video", "description": "Batch upload videos to YouTube with per-video metadata from `UPLOAD_META.md`. Survives SOCKS/HTTP proxies by using `requests` directly for resumable upload.", "source": "./wjs-uploading-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-converting-text-to-video", "description": "Turn a 王建硕-style WeChat article into a narrated 1080×1920 portrait MP4 (30–90s) — Volcano TTS voiceover, HyperFrames CSS/GSAP per-scene animation, subtle SFX, abstract watercolor background.", "source": "./wjs-converting-text-to-video"},
    {"name": "wjs-teaching-english", "description": "Turn a single English word into an HLS supercut lesson from a video base — stitches every clip where the word is spoken, prepended with a bilingual intro card (word + IPA + 中文 gloss + usage, Volcano TTS) and a follow-me CTA card.", "source": "./wjs-teaching-english"},
    {"name": "wjs-publishing-wechat", "description": "Polish a 微信公众号 (WeChat Official Account) article, generate a cover image (题图) and explanation illustration, and upload as a draft to mp.weixin.qq.com.", "source": "./wjs-publishing-wechat"},
    {"name": "wjs-mining-articles", "description": "Mine a video's SRT — a monologue / 讲解, or an interview where 王建硕 is one speaker — into multiple standalone 微信公众号 articles, one per distinct topic.", "source": "./wjs-mining-articles"},
    {"name": "wjs-mining-voicedrop", "description": "Turn uploaded VoiceDrop voice memos (the jianshuo.dev/files R2 inbox) into WeChat article drafts — pull the unprocessed recordings, transcribe, and mine articles from each.", "source": "./wjs-mining-voicedrop"},
    {"name": "wjs-distilling-style", "description": "Capture a writer's voice from a few sample articles and rewrite text to sound like that author. Works for any author, 王建硕 included.", "source": "./wjs-distilling-style"},
    {"name": "wjs-syndicating-articles", "description": "Auto-syndicate your newest 微信公众号 article across platforms — auto-posts to X / Bluesky / Threads / LinkedIn and prepares a copy-paste outbox for manual platforms (Facebook / 小红书 / 即刻 / 知乎).", "source": "./wjs-syndicating-articles"},
    {"name": "wjs-tweeting-from-articles", "description": "Post a daily X tweet inspired by your newest un-tweeted WeChat article — drafts 3 angle variants (quote / metaphor / one-liner), posts the chosen one via xurl, records history.", "source": "./wjs-tweeting-from-articles"},
    {"name": "wjs-x-improving-content", "description": "Systematically improve X content by A/B-testing the tweet-generation prompt — git-SHA-versioned, numbered experiments judged on median impressions per tweet, with per-tweet feature mining.", "source": "./wjs-x-improving-content"},
    {"name": "wjs-x-increasing-follower", "description": "Grow X followers via numbered, A/B-testable growth experiments — each with a hypothesis, target metric, rollback state, and verdict. North-star = new-follower ÷ profile-visit conversion.", "source": "./wjs-x-increasing-follower"},
    {"name": "wjs-polishing-x-engagement", "description": "Rewrite a plain Chinese tweet into a high-engagement version backed by real facts + an interaction hook. Returns 2–3 variants, short / plain / colloquial.", "source": "./wjs-polishing-x-engagement"},
    {"name": "wjs-cleaning-spam", "description": "Delete 引流 / emoji spam replies (同城面付 / 寻固炮 / 线下上门 etc.) under your X posts. Covers the last 7 days via X recent-search.", "source": "./wjs-cleaning-spam"},
    {"name": "wjs-publishing-hugo", "description": "Conversational backend for a Hugo static blog — add / edit posts, manage categories, upload images, commit, push, auto-deploy. No CMS, no server.", "source": "./wjs-publishing-hugo"},
    {"name": "wjs-converting-wp-to-hugo", "description": "Migrate a WordPress site (WXR export + uploads) to a Hugo static site on GitHub Pages — preserves /archives/<id>/ URLs, localizes images, deploys via GitHub Actions.", "source": "./wjs-converting-wp-to-hugo"},
    {"name": "wjs-publishing-testflight", "description": "Wire up fastlane + GitHub Actions for an iOS project so pushing main auto-builds and uploads to TestFlight.", "source": "./wjs-publishing-testflight"},
    {"name": "wjs-publishing-appstore", "description": "Ship a TestFlight iOS app to the App Store — prepare screenshots + description/metadata and submit for review via the existing fastlane setup.", "source": "./wjs-publishing-appstore"},
    {"name": "wjs-looping-feedback", "description": "Add an in-site feedback loop to a website repo — a floating 提个建议 button where allowlisted visitors' suggestions become GitHub Issues that Claude Code turns into auto-merged, auto-deployed code changes, with a /_feedback dashboard + one-click revert.", "source": "./wjs-looping-feedback"},
    {"name": "wjs-auditing-project", "description": "Holistic state-of-the-project audit: unmerged branches, stalled PRs, failed GitHub Actions, stale builds, plan drift, unreleased commits, log errors. Read-only investigation → grouped checklist → fix only after confirmation.", "source": "./wjs-auditing-project"},
    {"name": "wjs-promoting-skills", "description": "Automated daily promotion for your Claude Code skills — picks a skill, generates a marketing angle, auto-posts to X via xurl, and drafts community posts (Reddit / HN / Discord) to an outbox.", "source": "./wjs-promoting-skills"},
    {"name": "wjs-eating-and-growing", "description": "吃一堑长一智 — 6-step interactive reflection for personal setbacks. Diagnoses which layer (L1 notes / L2 in-the-moment trigger / L3 default-reaction practice) is missing and routes to the right modality, instead of letting every reflection become another notebook entry.", "source": "./wjs-eating-and-growing"},
    {"name": "wjs-voicedrop", "description": "VoiceDrop 配套 skill。两个模式 — (1) list：列出你在 VoiceDrop R2 上的全部文件（录音 / 文章 JSON / 标记）；(2) distill：从你的样本文章蒸馏文风，生成可贴入 VoiceDrop「设置→文风」的精简规则集，并可直接通过 Files API 上传。触发词：\"voicedrop list\"、\"列出 VoiceDrop 文件\"、\"voicedrop distill\"、\"蒸馏 VoiceDrop 文风\"、\"/wjs-voicedrop\"。", "source": "./wjs-voicedrop"},
    {"name": "wjs-evaling-voicedrop-prompts", "description": "wjs-evaling-voicedrop-prompts", "source": "./wjs-evaling-voicedrop-prompts"}
  ]
}

man:IgorGanapolsky/ThumbGate:
{
  "name": "thumbgate-marketplace",
  "version": "1.29.2",
  "owner": {
    "name": "Igor Ganapolsky",
    "email": "ig5973700@gmail.com"
  },
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "thumbgate",
      "description": "One 👎 becomes a hard rule the agent cannot bypass. Captures thumbs-down feedback, distills it into PreToolUse Pre-Action Checks, enforced across every future Claude Code session.",
      "longDescription": "ThumbGate is a tripwire, not a memory layer. When you thumbs-down an agent action — a force-push that overwrote a teammate's commit, a destructive SQL drop, a refactor you already rejected — ThumbGate captures the pattern, distills a one-sentence lesson, and installs it as a PreToolUse block. The next time the agent reaches for the same tool call shape, the hook fires before execution and Claude sees your own words back as the reason.\n\nThe enforcement lives in the hook, not in the model's context, so the agent cannot bypass it by forgetting, by being prompted around it, or by switching sessions. Same rule works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Amp, Cline, and OpenCode.\n\n33 pre-action checks shipped (force-push, destructive SQL, mass-delete, npm publish from wrong branch, deploy without verification). Budget enforcement (action count + time limits) prevents runaway agent sessions. NIST / SOC2 / OWASP / CWE compliance tags on every rule for enterprise teams. DPO training-pair export for teams running their own fine-tunes.\n\nFree tier: 2 feedback captures/day, 10 total captures, 3 active auto-promoted prevention rules, fully offline. Pro ($19/mo): hosted sync across machines and agent runtimes, dashboard, audit export.",
      "source": {
        "source": "npm",
        "package": "thumbgate"
      },
      "version": "1.29.2",
      "author": {
        "name": "Igor Ganapolsky",
        "email": "ig5973700@gmail.com",

      "skills": [

      "skills": [

      "skills": [

{
  "//": [
    "Client-facing marketplace manifest. This file ships INSIDE the plugin",
    "subtree so a `git subtree split --prefix=assette-plugin` push",
    "to Assette/assette-ai-plugin (the public mirror) carries it into",
    "the mirror's root. Clients then install from the MIRROR repo:",
    "    /plugin marketplace add Assette/assette-ai-plugin",
    "    /plugin install assette@assette",
    "Cowork users add the same marketplace through the desktop app:",
    "    Customize > Plugins > + Add marketplace > Assette/assette-ai-plugin",
    "",
    "The sibling marketplace at ast-mcp-server/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json",
    "is the INTERNAL install path (for platform engineers with access to the",
    "private source repo) and points at the assette-plugin/",
    "subdirectory of THIS repo. The two manifests are otherwise identical and",
    "MUST be version-bumped together when releasing.",
    "",
    "source.path = '.' because after the subtree split, this plugin's contents",
    "ARE the mirror repo's root."
  ],
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/marketplace.schema.json",
  "name": "assette",
  "metadata": {
    "description": "Assette platform plugins."
  },
  "owner": {
    "name": "Assette Engineering"
  },
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "assette",
      "description": "Assette implementation toolkit for Assette client firms. Bundles a Node.js MCP shim that proxies the hosted Assette server, the assette-plugin config/lifecycle skill, and the deck-analysis / implementation-pipeline commands, agents and tools; the author-facing skills (pptx, xlsx, docx, data-doc, block, data-object, classification, plus general orientation) and the deck-analysis skills are downloaded from the hosted server after B2C sign-in ('initialize assette' / 'update assette'). The fabricator skills still spawn Python on-demand (python-pptx / openpyxl / python-docx).",
      "version": "0.16.1",
      "category": "development",
      "source": {
        "source": "url",
        "url": "https://github.com/Assette/assette-ai-plugin.git",
        "ref": "main"
      },
      "homepage": "https://github.com/Assette/assette-ai-plugin"
    }
  ]
}
